<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+1 peak (~10% of the base) indicating the presence of carbon (13C). The M+2 peak is ~33% of the base, matching the characteristic 3:1 intensity ratio of chlorine isotopes (35Cl/37Cl). No 1:1 M+2 pattern (bromine) or ~4% M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
